claims.statement: The fragment describes opening Commit changes and entering a short meaningful file-change description, permitting multiple-author attribution with a coauthor-guide link. Opening a dialog or author metadata is not a completed commit, truthful attribution, consent, signed identity, passing review, or release; the linked guide was not newly reviewed.

The PR-context fragment conditionally offers entering a commit message or accepting the default when prompted. It does not mandate a prompt in every flow, establish message quality, actual commit identity, approval, successful merge, or deployment; no UI action was performed.
